newsitem.title: USA: CSCE coffee ends weaker in thin, pre-holiday trade.
newsitem.headline: CSCE coffee ends weaker in thin, pre-holiday trade.

text.p: CSCE coffee futures ended weaker in thin rangebound dealings Wednesday as locals relinquished their long positions ahead of the long holiday weekend, floor sources said.
"It was long liquidation by locals squaring their books before thay go home," a trader said.
CSCE will be closed Thursday and Friday in observance of U.S. Thanksgiving.
Benchmark March coffee settled 0.35 cent lower at 107.75 cents a lb after trading from 108.70 to 107.50. Spot December futures finished down 0.90 cent at 116.25, with the rest 0.15 to 1.60 lower.
Technically, traders said March resistance was seen near 110.20 cents, with support was pegged at 106.40 cents.
